true_dual_pairs.correction: Cube and icosahedron are not duals. Any cube↔icosahedron relation used by Arcanum is an embedding/compound relation and must not be called duality.

dodeca_icosa_dual_scale.face_center_construction: For an outer regular dodecahedron with circumradius R_d, its twelve face centers form an inner regular icosahedron with circumradius R_i = 0.7946544722917661 * R_d before any rescaling.
dodeca_icosa_dual_scale.important_boundary: This face-center dual scaling is not the same scale as other concentric cube/icosahedron/dodecahedron embeddings. Registry consumers must name which construction is being used.
